gloss: to consume; to use up; to spend (resources, energy, money)

definitions.gloss: to consume; to use up; to spend (resources, energy, money)
definitions.explanation: to consume; to use up; to spend (resources, energy, money)

examples.japanese: カロリーを{消費|しょうひ}する。
{日本|にほん}は{大量|たいりょう}のエネルギーを{消費|しょうひ}している。
examples.english: Japan consumes a large amount of energy.

examples.japanese: この{作業|さぎょう}には{予想|よそう}より{多|おお}くの{時間|じかん}を{消費|しょうひ}してしまった。
examples.english: This task ended up consuming more time than expected.

examples.japanese: {消費|しょうひ}{者|しゃ}は{品質|ひんしつ}と{価格|かかく}のバランスを{重視|じゅうし}するようになった。
examples.english: Consumers have come to value the balance between quality and price.

notes:
Refers to using up goods, energy, time, or other resources. In economics, it specifically refers to the consumption of goods and services by consumers, as opposed to production or saving.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {消費|しょうひ}{者|しゃ}: consumer
- {消費|しょうひ}{税|ぜい}: consumption tax (sales tax)
- {消費|しょうひ}{期限|きげん}: expiration date; use-by date
- {消費|しょうひ}{量|りょう}: consumption volume
- {個人|こじん}{消費|しょうひ}: personal consumption
- {消費|しょうひ}{社会|しゃかい}: consumer society

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {浪費|ろうひ}する: to waste; to squander — implies wasteful or excessive consumption
- {使|つか}う: to use — a general word for using something, without the nuance of using it up
- {費|つい}やす: to spend; to expend — emphasizes the deliberate investment of time, effort, or money toward a purpose
